questions.question: In "Friends", what is Chandler's surname?
questions.fact: Chandler's middle name is Muriel. Matthew Perry played him in all ten seasons, from 1994 to 2004.

questions.question: What is the title of Phoebe's most famous song in "Friends"?
questions.fact: Taylor Swift invited Lisa Kudrow on stage to sing "Smelly Cat" with her at a 2015 concert in Los Angeles.

questions.question: Which actress played Rachel Green in "Friends"?
questions.fact: Her layered haircut, nicknamed "The Rachel", was copied by millions of women in the 1990s.

questions.question: What alias does Walter White use as a drug maker in "Breaking Bad"?
questions.fact: The name comes from the German physicist Werner Heisenberg, famous for the uncertainty principle.

questions.question: In which US city is "Breaking Bad" set?
questions.fact: The real owners of Walt's TV house put up a fence after fans kept throwing pizzas onto the roof, copying a famous scene.

questions.question: Which actor played Jesse Pinkman in "Breaking Bad"?
questions.fact: Aaron Paul won three Emmys for the role, and returned as Jesse in the 2019 film "El Camino".

questions.question: Which actor played Walter White in "Breaking Bad"?
questions.fact: Before Walt, Cranston was best known as Hal, the goofy dad in the sitcom "Malcolm in the Middle".

questions.question: What is the name of Gus Fring's fried-chicken chain in "Breaking Bad"?
questions.fact: The restaurant scenes were filmed at a real Twisters fast-food restaurant in Albuquerque.

questions.question: What are House Stark's famous words in "Game of Thrones"?
questions.fact: "Fire and Blood" are the words of House Targaryen, "Hear Me Roar" of the Lannisters and "We Do Not Sow" of the Greyjoys.

questions.question: Who played Daenerys Targaryen in "Game of Thrones"?
questions.fact: She later revealed that she survived two brain aneurysms during the early years of filming the show.

questions.question: In "Game of Thrones", what does "Hodor" turn out to mean?
questions.fact: Kristian Nairn, the Northern Irish actor who played Hodor, is also a house music DJ.

questions.question: Which "Game of Thrones" character is nicknamed "the Imp"?
questions.fact: Peter Dinklage won four Emmys for playing Tyrion, in 2011, 2015, 2018 and 2019.

questions.question: In "Game of Thrones", what do we say to the God of Death?
questions.fact: Arya learns it from her sword teacher Syrio Forel. "Valar morghulis" means "all men must die" in High Valyrian.

questions.question: Which Basque islet with a hermitage stood in for Dragonstone in "Game of Thrones"?
questions.fact: Visitors climb about 240 steps to the hermitage, where ringing the bell three times is said to bring good luck.

questions.question: Who co-created and starred as David Brent in the original British "The Office"?
questions.fact: The British version ran for just 14 episodes, including two Christmas specials, before the much longer US remake.

questions.question: Who played Michael Scott in the US version of "The Office"?
questions.fact: Carell left after the seventh season. Will Ferrell appeared in his final episodes as a new manager.

questions.question: What crop does Dwight Schrute grow on his family farm in "The Office"?
questions.fact: Schrute Farms also works as a bed and breakfast in the show, with themed rooms such as "America" and "Irrigation".

questions.question: In which Pennsylvania city does the US "The Office" take place?
questions.fact: The opening credits show real shots of Scranton, but the show itself was filmed in California.

questions.question: In which fictional town is "Stranger Things" set?
questions.fact: The town is in 1980s Indiana, but the series was mostly filmed in and around Atlanta, Georgia.

questions.question: What is the dark parallel world in "Stranger Things" called?
questions.fact: Season 4 sent Kate Bush's 1985 song "Running Up That Hill" back up the charts in 2022.

questions.question: Which actress plays Eleven in "Stranger Things"?
questions.fact: She shaved her head for the role. Although British, she was born in Marbella, Spain, in 2004.

questions.question: In "Money Heist", the robbers' code names are all names of…
questions.fact: Tokyo, played by Úrsula Corberó, narrates the story. Other robbers include Berlin, Nairobi, Denver and Rio.

questions.question: In "La Casa de Papel", the robbers wear masks of which Spanish artist?
questions.fact: The show first aired on Antena 3 in 2017, then became a global hit after Netflix added it to its catalogue.

questions.question: Which Italian song do the robbers sing in "La Casa de Papel"?
questions.fact: "Bella Ciao" was an anthem of the Italian partisans who resisted fascism during the Second World War.

questions.question: What is the name of the private school in the Netflix series "Élite"?
questions.fact: The first season, in 2018, starred three actors from "La Casa de Papel": Miguel Herrán, Jaime Lorente and María Pedraza.

questions.question: Which actress played the young Queen Elizabeth II in the first two seasons of "The Crown"?
questions.fact: Olivia Colman took over for seasons 3 and 4, and Imelda Staunton played the Queen in the final two seasons.

questions.question: In "Squid Game", players must cut a shape out of which sweet without breaking it?
questions.fact: The candy, called dalgona, is a Korean street snack made from just melted sugar and a pinch of baking soda.

questions.question: What is the total prize money in season 1 of "Squid Game"?
questions.fact: Lee Jung-jae, who plays player 456, became the first Asian actor to win the Emmy for Lead Actor in a Drama, in 2022.

questions.question: Who plays Sherlock Holmes in the BBC series "Sherlock"?
questions.fact: Martin Freeman played Watson, and his then-partner Amanda Abbington played Watson's wife, Mary.

questions.question: Which drug lord is at the centre of the first two seasons of "Narcos"?
questions.fact: Brazilian actor Wagner Moura, who played Escobar, moved to Medellín to learn Spanish for the role.

questions.question: Which 2020 Netflix series follows the chess prodigy Beth Harmon?
questions.fact: Sales of chess sets reportedly soared after its release. Anya Taylor-Joy won a Golden Globe for the role.

questions.question: Which legendary actress voices the gossip writer Lady Whistledown in "Bridgerton"?
questions.fact: The series is based on Julia Quinn's novels and is produced by Shonda Rhimes' company, Shondaland.

questions.question: Which drama follows the survivors of the crash of Oceanic Flight 815?
questions.fact: The two-part pilot reportedly cost over 10 million dollars, one of the most expensive in TV history at the time.

questions.question: Mob boss Tony Soprano lives in which US state?
questions.fact: James Gandolfini won three Emmys as Tony. The show opens with Tony telling a psychiatrist about his panic attacks.

questions.question: Which series stars Kevin Spacey as the scheming politician Frank Underwood?
questions.fact: Released in 2013, it was Netflix's first big original drama, with a whole season released at once.

questions.question: Which sitcom is set in a Boston bar "where everybody knows your name"?
questions.fact: Kelsey Grammer played Frasier Crane for 20 years, first in "Cheers" and then in his own spin-off, "Frasier".

questions.question: In "Seinfeld", which neighbour across the hall always bursts in without knocking?
questions.fact: Kramer was based on Larry David's real neighbour Kenny Kramer, who later ran "Reality Tours" of real Seinfeld spots.

questions.question: What is Carrie Bradshaw's job in "Sex and the City"?
questions.fact: Her friends have the other jobs: Charlotte is an art dealer, Miranda a lawyer and Samantha runs a PR firm.

questions.question: What is the family's surname in "Downton Abbey"?
questions.fact: The head of the family is the Earl of Grantham. Highclere Castle in Hampshire played the house itself.

questions.question: What do fans call Grogu, the little green creature from "The Mandalorian"?
questions.fact: His real name, Grogu, was only revealed in the show's second season, in 2020.

questions.question: Which actress played Buffy in "Buffy the Vampire Slayer"?
questions.fact: The 1997 series followed a 1992 film version, in which Buffy was played by Kristy Swanson.

questions.question: What is Penny's job at the start of "The Big Bang Theory"?
questions.fact: She works at the Cheesecake Factory. Her maiden surname is never revealed in the whole series.

questions.question: In which US city is "The Wire" set?
questions.fact: Creator David Simon spent years as a crime reporter for The Baltimore Sun before making the show.

questions.question: In which town do the Simpsons live?
questions.fact: Matt Groening chose the name partly because so many US states have a town called Springfield.

questions.question: In the German series "Dark", in which fictional town do the time-travel mysteries happen?
questions.fact: "Dark" was Netflix's first German-language original series, released in 2017.

questions.question: Which Spanish series is set in a women's prison?
questions.fact: Alba Flores and Najwa Nimri starred in it, and later joined "La Casa de Papel" as Nairobi and Alicia Sierra.

questions.question: Which Spanish series follows a secret government department that protects history?
questions.fact: Its agents travel through doors to past eras, meeting figures such as Velázquez and Lope de Vega. It began on TVE in 2015.

questions.question: Which long-running Spanish sitcom is set in a Madrid block of flats at Desengaño 21?
questions.fact: Many of its cast later moved to "La que se avecina", a similar sitcom by the same creators.

questions.question: In "Cuéntame cómo pasó", what is the family's surname?
questions.fact: It ran on TVE from 2001 to 2023, telling Spain's recent history through one family, starting in 1968.

questions.question: Which actor plays Assane Diop in the French Netflix series "Lupin"?
questions.fact: Assane is inspired by Arsène Lupin, the gentleman thief created by French writer Maurice Leblanc in 1905.

questions.question: Who plays the title role in the 2022 Netflix series "Wednesday"?
questions.fact: Ortega said she choreographed her viral school-dance scene herself. Christina Ricci, the 1990s Wednesday, also appears.

questions.question: In "How I Met Your Mother", who tells the story to the kids?
questions.fact: Josh Radnor plays Ted on screen, but the older Ted telling the story is voiced by Bob Saget of "Full House".

questions.question: Which series is set at a Hawaiian luxury resort in its first season?
questions.fact: Season 2 moved to Sicily and season 3 to Thailand, each with a new group of rich guests.

questions.question: Ted Lasso is an American coach hired by a football club in which country?
questions.fact: Jason Sudeikis first played Ted in 2013 adverts for the American TV channel NBC's Premier League coverage.

questions.question: In "The Bear", the family sandwich shop is in which city?
questions.fact: The shop is based on Mr. Beef, a real Italian beef sandwich spot in Chicago, where outside shots are filmed.

questions.question: "Fawlty Towers" is set in a hotel in which English seaside town?
questions.fact: John Cleese based Basil on a famously rude hotel owner he met in Torquay. Manuel the waiter is "from Barcelona".

questions.question: Who created the Korean series "Squid Game"?
questions.fact: He reportedly wrote the script around 2008, but studios turned it down for about ten years.

questions.question: Which series follows Don Draper at a 1960s New York advertising agency?
questions.fact: Jon Hamm played Draper, and the show won the Emmy for Best Drama four years in a row, from 2008 to 2011.

questions.question: In "Suits", Mike Ross works as a top lawyer despite not having…
questions.fact: Meghan Markle played the paralegal Rachel Zane in "Suits" for seven seasons before marrying Prince Harry.

questions.question: Who starred as himself in "The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air"?
questions.fact: Smith also rapped the famous theme song, which tells how he moved from West Philadelphia to his rich relatives' house.
